response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS n FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.bats) SELECT bats, n AS appearance_count, n * 1.0 / SUM(n) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / AVG(n * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_avg_count FROM g

assumptions.assumption: Inner join on player_id drops appearances with no matching player. Players whose bats is NULL form their own group, separate from the empty-string group. The average count per group is taken over all groups returned, including the NULL group if it exists.
